page.text: This method deletes one or more messages from the chat of the group call. Deleting messages sent by other participants requires admin rights. Not supported in conference calls.
page.syntax-highlight:
from pytgcalls import PyTgCalls from pytgcalls import idle ...
app = PyTgCalls(client) app.start()
... # Call API methods
app.delete_messages( -1001185324811, [160185348, 160190468], )
idle()

subtext.text: Delete messages from the group call chat.
Identifier or list of identifiers of the messages to delete.
